name: Chester, Pennsylvania

rent.notes: One of the most affordable places near Philadelphia; ~30% below city rents. Older riverfront city undergoing redevelopment. Water, sewer, and trash are separate utility bills.

groceries.notes: 2 adults + pet food. Limited full-service supermarkets in-city; some residents shop neighboring Brookhaven/Aston.

utilities.taxes: Pennsylvania exempts residential utilities from sales tax.
utilities.notes: Electricity, gas, water, sewage, trash. Internet is in entertainment.

healthcare.notes: Medicare Part B + Medigap Plan G (x2) + Part D (x2) + dental/vision. Crozer-Chester Medical Center locally; Penn/Jefferson within the metro.

petCare.notes: Vet visits, vaccinations, flea/tick, pet insurance.

petDaycare.notes: Doggy daycare 2 days/week, large-breed rate. Suburban pricing.

transportation.notes: SEPTA Regional Rail (Wilmington/Newark Line) to Center City ~35 min; more car-dependent than inner-ring suburbs.

entertainment.notes: Incl cable+1Gig internet, streaming, dining out. Subaru Park (soccer) and riverfront venues nearby.

phoneCell.notes: T-Mobile 55+ Essentials. 2 phones, all taxes included.

buffer.notes: Monthly safety buffer for unexpected expenses.

medicalOOP.notes: Specialist visits, labs, and out-of-pocket shares after Medicare. Metro provider network.

medicine.notes: Monthly prescription medication costs for household.

taxes.notes: Estimated monthly income tax on $72,000/yr household income. PA flat 3.07% with SS/retirement exempt; no Philadelphia city wage tax (a 1% local EIT applies to earned income only, not retirement). Excludes sales/property tax.

healthcarePreMedicare.notes: ACA silver benchmark for a 2-adult household, both age ~60, before subsidies (county-level estimate, Delaware County). Shares Pennsylvania's Philadelphia-region rating area with Philadelphia, so the benchmark matches the Philadelphia base. Estimated +/-15% vs a healthcare.gov quote. Verify a specific ZIP on Pennie (pennie.com). Accessed 2026-07-29.

stateIncomeTax.exemptions: SS and all retirement income exempt from PA tax. Local Earned Income Tax (~1%) applies to earned income only, not retirement income. No Philadelphia city wage tax.

salesTax.notes: 6% state; Delaware County has no local sales-tax add-on (unlike Philadelphia's 8%).

propertyTax.notes: Not modeled for renters; Chester's effective property-tax rate is high but is reflected in rents.

taxes.notes: PA exempts all retirement income from state tax. Lower combined sales tax than Philadelphia (6% vs 8%) and no city wage tax.

acaMarketplace.notes: Pennie (PA state marketplace). Delaware County shares the Philadelphia-region rating area; benchmark matches the Philadelphia base.
acaMarketplace.disclaimer: Estimated +/-15% vs a healthcare.gov/Pennie quote. Verify a specific ZIP on pennie.com. Accessed 2026-07-29.

pros: Cheapest rents in the Philadelphia suburbs (~30% below city)
SEPTA Regional Rail to Center City
No Philadelphia city wage tax; lower 6% sales tax
PA exempts SS and retirement income from state tax
cons: Higher crime; do block-by-block safety diligence
